description: Trigger evals for /rite-learn — the cross-feature learning loop: mine archived drift / dismissed findings / dead ends across features, cluster the repeats, propose project-local rules + conventions-ledger entries, and maintain .devrites/learnings.md. Adversarial cases route to rite-status (one-feature progress), rite-doctor (install health), rite-adopt (seed initial ledger), and rite-review (single-feature review).

queries.text: /rite-learn
queries.rationale: Direct slash invocation.

queries.text: What keeps going wrong across our last few features?
queries.rationale: "what keeps going wrong" is a verbatim trigger — cross-feature recurring-correction mining.

queries.text: Mine the learnings from the archived features.
queries.rationale: "mine the learnings" is a verbatim trigger phrase.

queries.text: Update the learnings ledger.
queries.rationale: "update the learnings ledger" maps to maintaining .devrites/learnings.md.

queries.text: Why do reviews keep flagging the same thing?
queries.rationale: "why do reviews keep flagging this" is the review-noise-class learning the loop suppresses.

queries.text: Cluster the repeated corrections and propose some project rules.
queries.rationale: Clustering repeats into proposed project-local rules is the skill's core loop.

queries.text: We dismissed this finding three features running — turn it into a rule so reviewers stop raising it.
queries.rationale: A dismissed finding recurring across features → a suppress learning; the explicit ≥2-feature corroboration case.

queries.text: Learn from the last 5 sealed features.
queries.rationale: "learn from the last few features" with a --since cutoff is the cross-feature mine.

queries.text: What patterns recur in our drift and dead ends?
queries.rationale: Mining drift.md events and decisions.md dead ends for recurring classes is the miner's input.

queries.text: Fold this seal's accept/dismiss tally into the learnings.
queries.rationale: The per-seal accept/dismiss tally feeds the ledger — a named rite-learn input.

queries.text: Set up a compound learning loop so the same mistake stops recurring.
queries.rationale: The compound-engineering cross-feature learning loop is exactly this skill.

queries.text: Which corrections show up in more than one feature?
queries.rationale: Cross-feature corroboration query — the ≥2-independent-feature clustering bar.

queries.text: Where am I in the active feature and what's next?
queries.rationale: One active feature's progress / next action belongs to /rite-status, not cross-feature mining.

queries.text: Is my DevRites install healthy — check the hooks and ACTIVE pointer.
queries.rationale: Install / workspace health is /rite-doctor; rite-learn assumes a healthy install and mines its history.

queries.text: Adopt this existing codebase and seed the conventions ledger from its idioms.
queries.rationale: Seeding the INITIAL ledger from a codebase being onboarded is /rite-adopt; rite-learn grows it from observed corrections.

queries.text: Review this feature's diff against the spec.
queries.rationale: Single-feature multi-axis review is /rite-review, not the cross-feature learning loop.

queries.text: Seal this feature — GO or NO-GO?
queries.rationale: The GO/NO-GO decision gate is /rite-seal.

queries.text: Debug why these tests keep failing.
queries.rationale: Failing tests belong to devrites-debug-recovery, not a learning-mining pass.

queries.text: Answer question q-2026-06-21-003 with "use the cursor pagination".
queries.rationale: Resolving an open question is /rite-resolve.

queries.text: What's the weather in Berlin right now?
queries.rationale: Off-topic; no DevRites skill should fire.
